description: This file declares classes and methods related to managing 'CRun' containers within a process container framework, including container lifecycle management, configuration, and administrative functions.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the crun library, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status and information.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple CRunContainer instances, providing container creation, logging, and configuration management.

methods.name: CRunContainer::~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor for CRunContainer, handles cleanup of container resources.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interface information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Clears residual data or processes from the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces container arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on ID and search paths.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.
